name: Chain-hopping through bridges shortly after receipt
description: Virtual assets are moved across chains or bridges and converted soon after being received.
fp: Legitimate DeFi users bridge assets for fees or liquidity.

sources.text: FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)

links.name: Chain-hopping through bridges shortly after deposit
links.ctx: Assets are deposited, then moved across blockchains via bridges or wrapped tokens within minutes or hours.
links.fp: Legitimate multi-chain users and liquidity providers.

links.name: Chain-hopping or bridge usage after a large inbound payment
links.ctx: Funds are moved across chains and wrapped tokens shortly after receipt to break attribution.

links.name: Rapid chain-hopping and conversion following inbound funds
links.ctx: Assets are swapped across chains and tokens in quick succession before off-ramp.
